name: ranko
description: Your session's figures above the Claude Code prompt: how full the context is and how far off auto-compaction is, the prompt cache, your plan's limits and when they run full, the task list, and a Compact button. Beside them Ranko, the rankello® mascot, shows what Claude is doing: he types, thinks, waves when it waits for you, cheers and naps.

drag.title: Drag Ranko
drag.description: Press on Ranko and drag him along the band above the prompt; he dangles while held and lands where you let go.

pats.title: Pat Ranko
pats.description: A click on Ranko without dragging pats him: a squish, a happy squint and hearts.

toolProps.title: Tool props
toolProps.description: Ranko holds a prop for the tool Claude is using: a magnifier to read or search, a notepad and pencil to edit or keep the task list, binoculars for the web and the browser; otherwise he types on his laptop.

thinking.title: Thinking pose
thinking.description: While Claude thinks before it writes or calls a tool, Ranko puts a finger to his chin and looks up, the fingers of his other hand drumming on the keys.

miniRankos.title: Mini Rankos
miniRankos.description: Each running subagent gets a half-size Ranko beside the main one; it walks off when the subagent finishes.

stuffing.title: Stuffed by context
stuffing.description: Ranko grows rounder as the context window fills and deflates with a sigh when it is compacted.

blush.title: Blush at kind words
blush.description: Thanks or praise in a prompt, in English or German, makes Ranko blush.

attention.title: Wave when Claude waits
attention.description: When Claude waits for your permission or for your answer to a question, Ranko stops typing, stands up and waves, then says psst every half minute until you answer; after five minutes he dozes off.

thumbsUp.title: Thumbs up for work done
thumbsUp.description: A commit, a push, a pull request opened or merged, or a test run that passes gets a thumbs up from Ranko.

fidgets.title: Idle fidgets
fidgets.description: Left alone, Ranko now and then scratches his head, says psst, gives a thumbs up or looks around.

sounds.title: Sound effects
sounds.description: Little sounds for pats, jumps, wobbles, blushes, being picked up and put down, deflating and dozing off. They play on macOS; elsewhere Ranko stays silent.

stats.title: Session stats
stats.description: The figures of your session, beside Ranko: how full the context is and how far off auto-compaction is, how long the prompt cache stays warm, your plan's limits and when they run full, Claude's task list or the session, and a Compact button. Where Ranko can't be drawn they show without him; folded, in one line.

compactSummary.title: Compaction summaries
compactSummary.description: After /compact or the Compact button, the summary Claude carries on with is shown in the conversation, under a line with the tokens before and after. The lines are for you; Claude doesn't read them.
